parsedBody.post_text:
The bread or the key?

Everyone sees this a little different.

The explanation I like the most is the bread is tangible. He can grab it, and it feeds him straight away. It's the quick, safe choice.

The key is the unknown. Who knows what happens once that door swings open? Is it a risk your willing to take?

Having a startup feels the same way. Stepping into the unknown, unaware of all the hurdles that were coming up. Having to learn things on the go we didn't even know existed.
